initialize_BaseModelHG: initialize a BaseModelHG instance with training options including GPU IDs and checkpoint directory
save_network_BaseModelHG: save a PyTorch network state dict to a .pth file using save_network helper method
load_network_BaseModelHG: load a PyTorch network state dict from a .pth file using load_network helper method
set_input_BaseModelHG: set the input data for the BaseModelHG instance using the set_input method
test_BaseModelHG: run the BaseModelHG test method for inference without backpropagation
